rules.sentence: In individuals with recurrent disease with or without metastasis, surgical resection is preferred if possible; primarily, adjuvant chemotherapy is given.
A 5-year survival rate of 33% may be obtained in patients with a second surgical remission.[38][37]
In patients who are not candidates for surgery, chemotherapy with or without radiation is preferred.
In those with metastasis, dismal 5-year survival rates of 20%, which has remained unchanged over the past 25 years, underline the need to explore newer approaches.
